text:
- **Codex runs pm fully:** A Codex session now gets the same pm guarantees as a Claude Code session. The owner-request judge and the day summary also run on Codex.
- **Releases and upgrades:** Releases now publish from CI automatically under a written policy. `pm upgrade` now prints the guide of every release it crosses and prunes unused launcher pins.
- **Code layout and checks:** The command code now sits in noun-based packages, and the parser no longer imitates argparse. Sprint close checks only the covers patterns that the sprint changed.
- **Owner requests and feedback:** The owner chose a session-end feedback ask instead of a Stop-hook ask. A rule change in review says that opening owner-requested work needs no leave.
